_comment: What differs in the Firefox build of the extension, applied by scripts/build-firefox.mjs on top of extension/manifest.json (everything not named here is taken from it unchanged, so a permission added for Chrome reaches Firefox too). Firefox has no service workers (a module event page instead), no 'debugger' API (no CDP: the extension turns those features off, see extension/platform.js), no 'tabGroups' and no 'favicon' API.
